ycoss:2032.long_description: Today, over 50 million SMBs issue informal credit in India, This is a hugely manual process which they spend hours tracking, reconciling, and collecting! The 50M SMBs in India account for 40% of the nation’s GDP. As much as 60% of their sales happen on credit. That’s ~24% of the country’s GDP (500B$) lying on paper! OKCREDIT as a company came into existence to start solving the most important problem of credit recovery in MSMEs. We as first movers developed a bookkeeping app that would help any merchant sitting at the remotest corner of the country with internet connectivity to record his transactions digitally. We helped them track the credit given to their customers and suppliers. With our Okcredit app a merchant can track the amount of credit given, monitor credit limit, send reminders and eventually can collect faster from their customers. So as a company our vision was to bring the data dark merchants onto the digital platform. We have changed the way the MSMEs record the transactions and eased their life today.

ycoss:29295.long_description: Artisan builds AI employees for revenue teams. Our first, Ava, is the leading AI BDR: she finds and researches leads across a database of 400M+ contacts, writes and sends personalized email in your tone of voice, runs dialer call steps, handles every reply, and books meetings on the right rep's calendar. Over 90% of our customers run her fully autonomously. Artisan is a complete GTM ecosystem, not a point tool. One platform consolidates the 5-8 tool stack most teams stitch together at $100K+/year: prospecting data and waterfall enrichment (ZoomInfo, Apollo), list building and signals (Clay), sequencing (Outreach, Salesloft), parallel dialing (Nooks, Orum), website visitor identification, and buyer intent. It runs on top of Salesforce and HubSpot with owner mapping, do-not-contact enforcement, and field-level sync controls. We're built for enterprise. SOC 2 Type II, GDPR and CCPA compliant, SSO/SAML, role-based access, workspace isolation per brand, and a full audit trail on everything Ava does. The common enterprise pattern: sales ops runs Ava centrally for a thousand-plus AEs who never log in. Beyond the BDR job, Ava Inbound qualifies and books website visitors from the same knowledge base, and our AI AE runs live product demos and progresses deals. Prospecting, inbound, and the demo on one platform, one knowledge base, one AI sales team. YC W24. $35M+ raised from investors including Y Combinator and HubSpot Ventures. Thousands of customers including DoorDash, Quora, SumUp, CookUnity and SaaStr. Raise sourced over $700K in ARR in six months with Ava. SumUp runs leads at $52 each. Teams in San Francisco and New York. And we're hiring.

ycoss:29471.long_description: Senso is building the infrastructure for the agentic web. As AI agents replace websites as the primary interface for discovery, decisions, and commerce, enterprises need a new way to control how agents understand, reason over, and act on their data. Senso enables companies to register agent-first domains, ingest first-party enterprise data, and publish verified, structured ground truth that AI agents can safely answer from, recommend with, and transact against. ycoss:30.long_description: Matterport is an immersive media technology company that is shaking up the 3D / VR world. Our team has built the first end-to-end system for creating, modifying, distributing, and navigating immersive 3D and virtual reality (VR) versions of real-world spaces on web and mobile devices. Matterport offers the world's most inexpensive and simplest way to capture 3D spaces. Our products include: - Matterport Pro Camera for capturing real spaces in 3D. It collects accurate visual and spatial data to map entire areas in minutes and is all about automation and ease of use. - The Matterport Cloud for processing and hosting 3D models - Matterport Portal, our system for viewing, editing, and managing models; collaborating with colleagues; and sharing models with others - Matterport 3D Showcase, a browser-based 3D media player, which allows anyone to view 3D models in their browser with no additional software - Matterport Core VR: All Spaces can be converted to VR and experienced on Samsung Gear VR or Google Cardboard (in beta), with additional device support coming soon. Matterport 3D media solutions power industries from real estate (residential, multi-family and commercial) and travel and hospitality (hotels, vacation rentals, and venue booking), to business listings, architecture, engineering and construction, news and entertainment, and everything in between. We’re growing fast. If you’re passionate about solving cutting-edge problems in computer vision and hardware design and creating order-of-magnitude improvements in the ability to easily create and share 3D models of real world spaces, we want to talk to you. See open positions at matterport.com/jobs. Try Matterport for yourself at matterport.com/try.
